## Recoding quick distinction

- Recode in the AI workflow writes cleaner labels back to the selected label set.
- Collapse and Soft Recode Plus are filter/pipeline transformations for simplifying or harmonising labels in a view.
- Magnetisation/soft recoding maps raw labels to user-provided magnetic labels when similarity is high enough; unmatched labels stay visible unless the app setting drops them.
